title: Extend a prescribed generic embedding by a nonzero ideal
statement: Let $X$ be Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], $i:W\to X$ a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] with $W$ integral [def-pc-integral-scheme], and $G$ coherent [pqf-def-coherent]. Given an injective ambient-stalk-ring linear map $\psi:(i_*\mathcal O_W)_{i(\eta)}\to G_{i(\eta)}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk, def-pc-module-pullback], there are a nonzero quasi-coherent ideal $J$ of $W$ and a monomorphism $\alpha:i_*J\to G$ with $\alpha_{i(\eta)}=\psi\circ(i_*(J\hookrightarrow\mathcal O_W))_{i(\eta)}$. No target-rank assumption or generic surjectivity conclusion is asserted.

proof.text: Let H = i_* O_W. It is quasi-coherent by qcqs pushforward. On an affine open U of X, H(U) is the quotient Gamma(W,i^-1 U) of Gamma(X,U), so it is cyclic and finite. The affine finite-type criterion and the locally Noetherian coherence criterion imply H is coherent. This is the proved private helper coherent_closed_pushforward_unit, and does not use the general finite-pushforward coherence theorem.

Apply exists_open_hom_of_coherent_stalk_map to the prescribed stalk map psi using coherence of H and G. It gives U containing i(eta), a restricted morphism phi, and the elementwise stalk equality transported by restrictStalkNatIso.

Apply local_closed_ideal_map_extension to phi. Obtain J != 0 and alpha from i_*J to G whose restriction equals the restricted ideal inclusion followed by phi. Naturality of the restriction-stalk isomorphisms, both their hom and inv, transports this equality to the asserted equality alpha_eta = inclusion_eta followed by psi.

The pushed ideal inclusion is injective on every open, by injective_toModulesι_app evaluated on inverse-image opens. Mathlib stalkFunctor_map_injective_of_app_injective makes its generic stalk injective. The stalk equality and hpsi make alpha generically injective. For any f:F -> i_*J with zero generic stalk, compose with the ideal inclusion into i_*O_W. On an open U whose inverse image is nonempty, the generic point of W belongs to i^-1 U. Vanishing of the generic germ gives zero after restricting to a smaller ambient neighborhood; its inverse image still contains eta. The integral-scheme restriction map on functions is injective, so the original section is zero. Sheaf section extensionality handles empty opens as well. Sectionwise injectivity of J -> O_W then gives f = 0. Apply this to kernel.ι alpha: functoriality and cancellation by the injective alpha_eta make its generic stalk zero. Thus kernel.ι alpha is zero, and Abelian.mono_of_kernel_ι_eq_zero proves Mono alpha. All these steps are proved private helpers or Mathlib results; no coherent-kernel descent is needed.

proof_origin.place: P2 formal reduction: affine cyclic coherence, local ideal extension, restriction-stalk naturality, and direct integral restriction injectivity

theorem generic_ideal_stalk_embedding_extension {X W : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (i : W ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsIntegral W]
    (G : X.Modules) (hGcoh : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace G)
    (ψ : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace
        (i.base (genericPoint W))).obj ((pushforward i).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit W.ringCatSheaf)) ⟶
      (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace
        (i.base (genericPoint W))).obj G)
    (hψ : Function.Injective ψ) :
    ∃ (J : W.IdealSheafData), J ≠ ⊥ ∧
      ∃ (α : (pushforward i).obj J.toModules ⟶ G), Mono α ∧
        (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace
          (i.base (genericPoint W))).map α =
        (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace
          (i.base (genericPoint W))).map ((pushforward i).map J.toModulesι) ≫ ψ
